product.name: Tomo Timer
product.tagline: A one-knob desk timer that tells you when to take a break.
product.summary: Tomo Timer is a palm-sized USB-C desk timer. Turn the knob to set minutes, press it to start, and a soft light ring counts down. When time is up it chimes once and glows amber until you press the knob again.
audience: People who work at a desk and forget to take breaks
product.problem: Phone timers pull you into notifications; you wanted a timer you can set without looking at a screen.
value: Set a timer in one twist
No app, no account, no notifications
product.vision: I wanted something my grandmother could use without instructions.

facts.text: The knob sets 1 to 90 minutes in 1-minute steps.
Power is USB-C 5 V, under 0.5 W.
The enclosure is 62 mm across and 28 mm tall.
A 12-LED ring shows the remaining time.
